svg.title: Round 1: three runs on the capped score
svg.desc: A grid with one row per training run on the capped score and two columns. Left column: real progress (milestones reached, average of 8 test episodes) at each checkpoint, with the average of the runs trained before the patch marked for comparison. Right column: the share of that checkpoint's capped score that came from levelling up.
svg.text: ROUND 1: THREE RUNS ON THE PATCHED SCORE
one bar per checkpoint (8 test episodes each); start: Oak's Lab with Squirtle
